title: Soil & Cellar: Flinders Truffles x Polperro Winery
summary: Afternoon truffle hunt at Flinders Truffles, then a truffle-matched dinner at Polperro Winery with Sam Coverdale's wines. One ticket, one winter day.
accessibilityNotes: Truffle hunt on farm terrain, not wheelchair accessible; dinner venue, check with Polperro
weatherDependency: Hunt is outdoors in winter, warm clothes and waterproof footwear; dinner is indoor
nearbyAttractions: Red Hill Truffles; Stonier Wines; Many Little restaurant
suggestedItineraryPairing: Stay at Polperro Villas for a full weekend wine and truffle immersion; include Stonier cellar door visit
editorVerdict: Truffle hunt then truffle dinner with Polperro pouring. The most complete winter food experience the Peninsula runs.
editorNote:
Two halves of the same day. The first: 2pm to 5pm at Flinders Truffles, working dogs in the rows, your own paper bag and (if you're lucky) a black winter truffle on the table by the end. The second: 6:30pm at Polperro Winery Restaurant where chef and winemaker Sam Coverdale have built a truffle-led menu with matched flights of the current Polperro releases.

For couples and serious food people. Booked properly it's the calendar winter date on the Peninsula. There is also a morning hunt (11am to 1pm) with a separate dinner, ask Polperro when you book.

Dress for a wet paddock: gumboots, beanie, layers. Stay at Polperro Villas so the day doesn't end with a drive home. Pricing isn't published, you have to call Polperro directly.
